thread_text:
Marta Ruiz: FYI got a ticket from ACME — their rerank calls started returning nonsense after a migration yesterday. They say scores are all 0.0 for some queries and sometimes we return a 400 with a cryptic message.

Support Bot: New ticket #4227 created by acme-support. Attachments: request logs + snippet.

Marta Ruiz: Pasting the customer's short repro they sent. They compute embeddings with text-embed-small (dim=1024), but their reranker was configured originally for text-embed-large (dim=1536). They said they didn't change the rerank config.

Samir Patel: Can we see the actual request/response?

Marta Ruiz: Yes, customer included this curl (sanitized):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \  -d '{"query":"best electric scooters under $500","candidates":["Scooter A","Scooter B"],"candidate_embeddings":[[0.012,0.34,...1024 values...],[0.11,0.24,...]]}'
```

Marta Ruiz: Customer says the response was either:

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{ "scores": [0.0, 0.0], "note": "computed but low confidence" }
```

or sometimes:

```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{ "error": "embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536 got 1024", "code": "E_EMBED_DIM" }
```

Alex Chen: That error message (E_EMBED_DIM) is good — but the 200 + all zeros is not. Looks like when the backend accepts the request but the dot-product/normalize kernel gets vector length it wasn't expecting and produces underflow/zeros. Could be a silent fallback path when candidate_embeddings provided without specifying embed_model.

Jae Lin: I dug into the rerank path in eng-runtime earlier. If "candidate_embeddings" are present we skip re-embedding, but we still expect the embeddings to match the configured reranker dim. There's a code path that tries to auto-detect dim and if detection fails it logs and returns zeroed scores instead of a helpful error. I'll add a guard.

Samir Patel: Do we know whether their index (Redis/Pinecone) was built with the larger model? If they migrated embedding model on producer side, index may have mixed dims.

Marta Ruiz: Customer confirmed they switched to text-embedding-3-small for cost reasons and forgot to reindex.

Alex Chen: Reproduction steps for ENG: create two candidate vectors of length 1024 and call rerank configured with expected_dim=1536. Run both code paths (candidate_embeddings present, and absence so the server re-embeds).

Alex Chen: Minimal repro curl for us (local):

```
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/rerank \ -H 'Authorization: Bearer test' \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -d '{"query":"q","candidates":["a","b"],"candidate_embeddings":[[0.1,0.2,...1024],[0.2,0.3,...1024]]}'
```

Jae Lin: Expected server behavior: return 400 with E_EMBED_DIM and a hint: "reindex or pass embed_model param to re-embed queries". Actual for some calls: 200 + zeros. I'll add a unit test to fail loudly.

Samir Patel: Short-term workaround for the customer: re-run embeddings with the same model used to build the index (text-embedding-3-large) or reindex their vector DB with the new small model. Also they can pass "embed_model":"text-embedding-3-large" in rerank call to force server-side embedding of the query (if they don't pass candidate_embeddings).

Marta Ruiz: Customer asked if we can auto-convert 1024->1536. Answer: no, you can't reliably expand embedding dimensionality. We should explain that in docs.

Alex Chen: Also added: check that candidate_embeddings are sent as float32 arrays (not strings/base64). We had one case where client serialized to strings and server parsed to zeros. Add validation to parse errors.

Samir Patel: Any chance this was an auth/billing issue? The logs show valid customer key and quota, so no.

Jae Lin: Plan of action: 1) Fail loudly in runtime when dim mismatch (PR coming) 2) Add a clearer E_EMBED_DIM message with remediation steps (docs link) 3) Add telemetry to catch how many calls currently hit the zero-score fallback 4) Notify devex to add a small KB and a sample repro.

Marta Ruiz: I'll let the customer know the workaround (recompute or reindex) and that we're fixing the silent-zero bug. Will ask for a small log bundle to attach if they want us to verify their vectors.

Alex Chen: I'll own the PR for the guard and telemetry. Assigning to me.

Samir Patel: I'll draft the KB note and add a snippet on correct rerank payloads and expected dims.

Jae Lin: Quick note for SRE — if we start returning E_EMBED_DIM more often for a customer, we shouldn't count those against rate limits while they troubleshoot. @eng-sre FYI.

Marta Ruiz: Thanks all. Customer reply: "Thanks — we can re-run embeddings overnight and will re-open if still broken." :thumbsup:

Support Bot: Ticket #4227 updated: status -> investigating.

Alex Chen: small TODOs: add unit test for candidate_embeddings length check, add error code doc, patch logs. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Jae Lin: I'll also audit other places where we accept precomputed vectors to ensure consistent validation.

Marta Ruiz: Closing loop: follow-up scheduled in 48h with customer.
